# OMP Session Gateway

> Secure, zero-touch mobile access to every running Oh My Pi (OMP) session. An Android-first
> PWA plus a loopback-only directory and just-in-time View/Control capability broker behind
> Tailscale Serve; opening a session hands off to OMP's own end-to-end-encrypted collab-web
> client. Stable v0.3.0 requires exact patched OMP v18.1.14; development targets stock mainline
> OMP v18.1.20 or newer, which carries that patch upstream. Community project; not affiliated
> with or endorsed by the Oh My Pi maintainers.

## Canonical documents

- [README](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-session-gateway#readme): problem, user experience, build and run, how it compares
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-session-gateway/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): qualified host/client/OMP combinations and support policy
- [Release status](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-session-gateway/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_STATUS.md): per-candidate qualification evidence, authoritative where docs disagree
- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-session-gateway/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, capability handling, acceptance gates
- [Architecture](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-session-gateway/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): trust boundaries and components
- [Protocol](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-session-gateway/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL.md): IPC and HTTP contracts
- [Operations](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-session-gateway/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): install, Tailscale Serve, doctor, upgrade
- [OMP patch route](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-session-gateway/blob/main/patches/oh-my-pi/README.md): exact controller/publisher patch for the pinned OMP
- [Stable release lock](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-session-gateway/blob/main/STABLE_RELEASE.lock.json) and [upstream lock](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-session-gateway/blob/main/UPSTREAM.lock.json): machine-readable current claim
